a.lede: The company is suspending the feature after security researchers discovered how easy it was to access sensitive information shared with the AI assistant.
a.title: A Design Flaw in Share Links Exposes Users’ Personal Conversations With Meta’s Muse

b.lede: Researchers accessed 6,800 shared conversations with the AI agent, including internal company documents.
b.title: Meta suspends Muse chats sharing feature after it left private details exposed
